sn46.40:1.1: Pañcime bhikkhave nīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā || || Katame pañca || || Kāmacchandanīvaraṇam bhikkhave andhakaraṇam āññāṇakaraṇam acakkhukaraṇam paññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhiyam anibbāna{saṃvattanikaṃ} || Byāpādanīvaraṇam bhikkhave ||la [pe] || Thīnamiddhanīvaraṇam bhikkhave ||la-pe || Uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇam bhikkhave ||la [pe] || || Vicikicchānīvaraṇam bhikkhave andhakaraṇam acakkhukaraṇam aññāṇakaraṇam aññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhiyam anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ || || Ime kho bhikkhave pañcanīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā || ||
sn46.40:2.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuddhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikā || || Katame satta || || Satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko || la-pe || || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko || || Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñaṇakaraṇā paññavuddhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikāti Nīvaraṇavaggo catuttho || ||
sn46.40:3.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Dve Kusalā Kilesā ca || Dve Yoniso ca Vuddhi ca || Āvaraṇo Aparihāni || Nīvaraṇavaraṇa
